    ],

)
def alpha_v28(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    """
    V28: 跨数据集Alpha - 分析师EPS主导策略
    
    V27分析: Sharpe 1.56接近达标，需最后一击
    优化方向:
    1. truncation 0.08 → 0.10 放大极值信号
    2. INDUSTRY中性化 (比SUBINDUSTRY更稳定)
    3. EPS动量权重提升 (分析师调整是最直接的基本面信号)
    
    经济学假设:
    1. secondary_sentiment_average: 市场情绪代理
    2. EPS变化率: 分析师盈利预期的实际调整，直接反映基本面
    3. sales变化率: 营收增长预期，验证EPS趋势
    
    三重验证: 情绪 × 盈利调整 × 营收增长
    """
    sec = data.secondary_sentiment_average.astype(np.float64)
    eps = data.anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_eps_mean.astype(np.float64)
    sales = data.anl4_fs_detail_estimates_basic_af_v4_nd_sales_mean.astype(np.float64)

    def cs_rank(arr):
        finite = np.where(np.isfinite(arr), arr, np.nan)
        valid = ~np.isnan(finite)
        if not np.any(valid):
            return np.full_like(arr, np.nan)
        result = np.full_like(finite, np.nan)
        sorted_idx = np.argsort(np.argsort(finite[valid]))
        result[valid] = sorted_idx / max(np.sum(valid) - 1, 1)
        return result

    def ts_mean(arr, window):
        if arr.shape[0] < window:
            return np.full_like(arr[-1], np.nan)
        return np.nanmean(arr[-window:], axis=0)

    def ts_delta(arr, period):
        if arr.shape[0] <= period:
            return np.full_like(arr[-1], np.nan)
        return arr[-1] - arr[-1 - period]

    # 22天情绪均值
    sec_22d = ts_mean(sec, 22)
    
    # EPS 11天变化率
    eps_d11 = ts_delta(eps, 11)
    
    # Sales 11天变化率
    sales_d11 = ts_delta(sales, 11)
    
    # 截面rank
    r_sec = cs_rank(sec_22d)
    r_eps = cs_rank(eps_d11)
    r_sales = cs_rank(sales_d11)
    
    # 信号组合: EPS主导 (40%) + 情绪 (35%) + 销售 (25%)
    signal = 0.40 * r_eps + 0.35 * r_sec + 0.25 * r_sales

    u = data.universe[-1]
    signal = signal.copy()
    signal[~u.astype(bool)] = np.nan

    return signal.astype(np.float32)

@alpha(data=["anl4_afv4_eps_mean", "earnings_quality_region_rank_current"], store=[])

    """

    经济学假设: V102 的 63-day EPS revision 与 prod pool 中的中长期动量 alphas 高度相关.
    改为 21-day revision (月度) 创造短期反转偏好, 与 prod pool 中的中长期 momentum 结构性正交.
    """
    eps_mean = data.anl4_afv4_eps_mean[-1].astype(np.float64)
    if data.anl4_afv4_eps_mean.shape[0] >= 21:
        eps_past = data.anl4_afv4_eps_mean[-21].astype(np.float64)
    else:
        eps_past = eps_mean
    eq_rank = data.earnings_quality_region_rank_current[-1].astype(np.float64)

    def cs_rank(arr):
        finite = np.where(np.isfinite(arr), arr, np.nan)
        valid = ~np.isnan(finite)
        if not np.any(valid):
            return arr
        result = np.full_like(finite, np.nan)
        sorted_idx = np.argsort(np.argsort(finite[valid]))
        result[valid] = sorted_idx / max(np.sum(valid) - 1, 1)
        return result

    def zscore(arr, clip=3.0):
        valid = ~np.isnan(arr)
        if valid.sum() < 10:
            return arr
        mean = np.nanmean(arr[valid])
        std = np.nanstd(arr[valid])
        if std < 1e-8:
            return arr - mean
        result = np.full_like(arr, np.nan)
        result[valid] = np.clip((arr[valid] - mean) / std, -clip, clip)
        return result

    z_eq = zscore(eq_rank, 3.0)
    z_mean = zscore(eps_mean, 3.0)

    r_mean = cs_rank(z_mean)

    p = 0.30
    r_rev_p = np.sign(r_rev) * np.power(np.abs(r_rev) + 1e-8, p)
    r_eq_p = np.sign(r_eq) * np.power(np.abs(r_eq) + 1e-8, p)
    r_mean_p = np.sign(r_mean) * np.power(np.abs(r_mean) + 1e-8, p)

    signal = 0.45 * r_rev_p + 0.40 * r_eq_p + 0.15 * r_mean_p

    u = data.universe[-1]
    signal = signal.copy()
    signal[~u.astype(bool)] = np.nan

    return signal.astype(np.float32)

def pasteurize(a, u):
    a = a.copy()
    a[~u.astype(bool)] = np.nan
    return a


def neutralize(a):
    a0 = np.nan_to_num(a, nan=0, posinf=0, neginf=0)
    return a - np.nanmean(a0)


def scale(a):
    a0 = np.nan_to_num(a, nan=0, posinf=0, neginf=0)
    norm = np.linalg.norm(a0, ord=1)
    return a / norm if norm > 0 else a

            ranks[valid] = ranks[valid] / valid.sum()

        if valid.sum() > 0:
            ranks = np.zeros_like(row)
            ranks[valid] = np.argsort(np.argsort(row[valid])) + 1
            ranks[valid] = ranks[valid] / valid.sum()
            ranked_sh[i] = ranks

@alpha(data=["mcr61_totalreturninvestibleweight", "mcr61_onedaynetreturn", "mcr61_onedayadjustedpricereturn"], store=[])
def wf_div_v29(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    trw = data.mcr61_totalreturninvestibleweight[-252:]
    r_net = data.mcr61_onedaynetreturn[-252:]
    r_adj = data.mcr61_onedayadjustedpricereturn[-252:]
    u = data.universe[-1]
    valid = u.astype(bool)

    def sz(x):
        m = valid & np.isfinite(x)
        xx = x.copy(); xx[~m] = np.nan
        mu = np.nanmean(xx); sd = np.nanstd(xx)
        sd = np.where((sd is None) | ~np.isfinite(sd) | (sd < 1e-10), 1.0, sd)
        z = (x - mu) / sd
        z = np.clip(z, -4.0, 4.0).astype(np.float32)
        z[~m] = np.nan
        return z

    def lc(a, b):
        m = (a > 0) & (b > 0) & valid & np.isfinite(a) & np.isfinite(b)
        o = np.full_like(a, np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
        o = np.where(m, np.log(a / b), np.nan)
        return o

    # wf: ultra-long momentum (60d+120d)
    w0 = trw[-1]; w60 = trw[-60]; w120 = trw[-120]
    r60 = np.nansum(r_adj[-60:], axis=0)
    r120 = np.nansum(r_adj[-120:], axis=0)
    wf = 0.5 * sz(lc(w0, w60) - r60) + 0.5 * sz(lc(w0, w120) - r120)

    # div: dv=0.50, 252d=50%
    rn60 = np.nansum(r_net[-60:], axis=0)
    ra60 = np.nansum(r_adj[-60:], axis=0)
    rn120 = np.nansum(r_net[-120:], axis=0)
    ra120 = np.nansum(r_adj[-120:], axis=0)
    rn252 = np.nansum(r_net[-252:], axis=0)
    ra252 = np.nansum(r_adj[-252:], axis=0)
    div = 0.3*(rn60-ra60) + 0.4*(rn120-ra120) + 0.3*(rn252-ra252)
    dv = sz(div)

    # rev: 20d mean reversion
    r20_sum = np.nansum(r_adj[-20:], axis=0)
    rev = -0.15 * sz(r20_sum)

    sig = 0.50*wf + 0.50*dv + rev
    sig = np.where(u, sig, np.nan)
    return sig.astype(np.float32)

def pasteurize(a, u):
    a = a.copy()
    a[~u.astype(bool)] = np.nan
    return a


def neutralize(a):
    a0 = np.nan_to_num(a, nan=0, posinf=0, neginf=0)
    return a - np.nanmean(a0)


def scale(a):
    a0 = np.nan_to_num(a, nan=0, posinf=0, neginf=0)
    norm = np.linalg.norm(a0, ord=1)
    return a / norm if norm > 1e-10 else a

        n_valid = np.sum(~np.isnan(x))
        if n_valid > 1:

        rank[np.isnan(x)] = np.nan

@alpha(data=["mdl28_sm_structural__credit_structural_leverage", "mdl28_sm_structural_credit_structural_distance_to_default"], store=[])
def my_alpha(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    leverage = data.mdl28_sm_structural__credit_structural_leverage.copy()
    dist_to_default = data.mdl28_sm_structural_credit_structural_distance_to_default.copy()

    for x in [leverage, dist_to_default]:
        col_mean = np.nanmean(x, axis=0, keepdims=True)
        col_std = np.nanstd(x, axis=0, keepdims=True)
        upper = col_mean + 4 * col_std
        lower = col_mean - 4 * col_std
        np.clip(x, lower, upper, out=x)

    window = 22
    n_times = leverage.shape[0]

    if n_times >= window:
        cum = np.nancumsum(leverage, axis=0)
        cum_shift = np.roll(cum, window, axis=0)
        cum_shift[:window] = 0
        count = np.cumsum(~np.isnan(leverage), axis=0).astype(float)
        count_shift = np.roll(count, window, axis=0)
        count_shift[:window] = 0
        rolling_mean = (cum - cum_shift) / np.maximum(count - count_shift, 1)
        cum_sq = np.nancumsum(leverage**2, axis=0)
        cum_sq_shift = np.roll(cum_sq, window, axis=0)
        cum_sq_shift[:window] = 0
        rolling_var = (cum_sq - cum_sq_shift) / np.maximum(count - count_shift, 1) - rolling_mean**2
        rolling_var = np.maximum(rolling_var, 0)
        rolling_std = np.sqrt(rolling_var)
        lev_z = (leverage[-1, :] - rolling_mean[-1, :]) / np.maximum(rolling_std[-1, :], 1e-10)
    else:
        col_mean = np.nanmean(leverage, axis=0)
        col_std = np.nanstd(leverage, axis=0)
        lev_z = (leverage[-1, :] - col_mean) / np.maximum(col_std, 1e-10)

    if n_times >= window:
        cum = np.nancumsum(dist_to_default, axis=0)
        cum_shift = np.roll(cum, window, axis=0)
        cum_shift[:window] = 0
        count = np.cumsum(~np.isnan(dist_to_default), axis=0).astype(float)
        count_shift = np.roll(count, window, axis=0)
        count_shift[:window] = 0
        rolling_mean = (cum - cum_shift) / np.maximum(count - count_shift, 1)
        cum_sq = np.nancumsum(dist_to_default**2, axis=0)
        cum_sq_shift = np.roll(cum_sq, window, axis=0)
        cum_sq_shift[:window] = 0
        rolling_var = (cum_sq - cum_sq_shift) / np.maximum(count - count_shift, 1) - rolling_mean**2
        rolling_var = np.maximum(rolling_var, 0)
        rolling_std = np.sqrt(rolling_var)
        d2d_z = (dist_to_default[-1, :] - rolling_mean[-1, :]) / np.maximum(rolling_std[-1, :], 1e-10)
    else:
        col_mean = np.nanmean(dist_to_default, axis=0)
        col_std = np.nanstd(dist_to_default, axis=0)
        d2d_z = (dist_to_default[-1, :] - col_mean) / np.maximum(col_std, 1e-10)

    result = -( -lev_z + d2d_z )
    result = np.where(np.isnan(result) | np.isinf(result), 0, result)
    result = np.clip(result, -3, 3)
    return result.astype(np.float32)

@alpha(data=["voting_beneficial_equity_shares","book_value_per_share_last_year","returns"], store=["y_sig"])
def a(data, store) -> npt.NDArray[np.float32]:
    v = np.asarray(data.voting_beneficial_equity_shares, dtype=np.float32)
    b = np.asarray(data.book_value_per_share_last_year, dtype=np.float32)
    r = np.asarray(data.returns, dtype=np.float32)
    u = np.asarray(data.universe, dtype=bool)
    N = v.shape[1]; T = v.shape[0]; tu = u[-1]

    # Rolling mean smoothing for v and b before ts_rank
    # 20-day rolling mean reduces daily noise
    def rolling_mean_2d(arr, window):
        out = np.full_like(arr, np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
        for t in range(T):
            start = max(0, t - window + 1)
            vals = arr[start:t+1]
            out[t] = np.nanmean(vals, axis=0)
        return out

    v_smooth = rolling_mean_2d(v, 20)
    b_smooth = rolling_mean_2d(b, 20)

    # ts_backfill(120) + winsorize(std=4) for v
    bf = np.full(N, np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
    win = min(120, T)
    blk = v[:win]
    for t in range(win - 1, -1, -1):
        row = blk[t]
        m = np.isnan(bf) & ~np.isnan(row)
        bf[m] = row[m]
    valid = ~np.isnan(bf)
    if valid.any():
        mu = float(np.nanmean(bf)); sd = float(np.nanstd(bf))
        if sd > 0:
            lo = mu - 4*sd; hi = mu + 4*sd
            bf = np.where(bf < lo, lo, bf)
            bf = np.where(bf > hi, hi, bf)
    bf = bf.astype(np.float32)

    # ts_rank
    def tr(hist, target):
        out = np.full(N, np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
        for j in range(N):
            col = hist[:, j]
            t = target[j]
            if np.isnan(t): continue
            vc = col[~np.isnan(col)]
            if vc.size == 0: continue
            out[j] = float((vc < t).sum()) / max(vc.size - 1, 1)
        return out

    win252 = min(252, T)
    # Use smoothed data for ts_rank calculation
    rs = tr(v_smooth[-win252:], v_smooth[-1])
    rv = tr(b_smooth[-win252:], b_smooth[-1])
    m5 = np.nanmean(r[-5:], axis=0)
    rm = np.full((T, N), np.nan, dtype=np.float32)
    for t in range(T):
        rm[t] = np.nanmean(r[max(0, t-4):t+1], axis=0)
    rk = tr(rm, m5)

    sig_today = (rs + rv - rk).astype(np.float32)
    sig_today[~tu] = np.nan

    # Keep original smoothing 80/20
    if store.y_sig is None:
        store.y_sig = sig_today
        sig = sig_today
    else:
        sig_y = store.y_sig
        sig = np.where(np.isnan(sig_today), sig_y,
                       0.8 * sig_today + 0.2 * np.where(np.isnan(sig_y), sig_today, sig_y))
        sig = sig.astype(np.float32)
        store.y_sig = sig_today

    sig[~tu] = np.nan
    fin = ~np.isnan(sig)
    if fin.any():
        sig = sig - float(np.nanmean(sig))
        l1 = float(np.nansum(np.abs(sig)))
        if l1 > 0: sig = sig / l1
        sig[~np.isfinite(sig)] = 0.0
    return sig.astype(np.float32)
